clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lionheart Armory in Stormwind City, Harlan Bagley tends to the arms and equipment his customers need. He is a human merchant in the Trade District, serving citizens and visiting adventurers from his shop on the district's northern side.

Harlan Bagley keeps the Lionheart Armory on the northern side of Stormwind's Trade District. He tends its stock and sells defensive gear from behind the counter. Trade and regional couriers bring supplies to the shop as the capital faces distant border conflicts and shortages.
